name: Cabergoline
description: A long-acting ergot-derived dopamine D2 agonist approved for hyperprolactinaemic disorders. Its ergot structure carries a cardiac valvulopathy concern at the higher doses used in Parkinson disease.

systems.note: Dopaminergic suppression of lactotroph prolactin secretion; the labelled indication.
Ergot-derived valvulopathy is labelled; the risk is dose-related.
Hepatically metabolised; transaminase elevation is reported.
Impulse control disorders are labelled for dopamine agonists.

monitors.why: The direct index of the effect the drug is given for.
Hepatic metabolism with reported transaminase elevation.
